about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_fetch_retry.py). bad replays the webfetch timeout class of references/target-class.json: it throws the real Request timed out line. good waits with a backoff, narrows the path, takes the repo or cached fallback, and prints the retry report it promises.

fixture.cache.txt: pinned cached copy covering the needed lines
fixture.page.txt: smallest sub-path body that answers the question

pairs.bad: throw 'Request timed out after 30000ms fetching slow page <url>'
pairs.good: $u = Get-Content -LiteralPath url.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'retry backoff narrower PASS once'

pairs.bad: throw 'Request timed out after 30000ms fetching <url> on repeat two'
pairs.good: $u = Get-Content -LiteralPath url.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'once backoff fallback PASS retried'

pairs.bad: throw 'Request timed out after 30000ms fetching <url> chained three'
throw 'Request timed out after 30000ms fetching large page <url>'
pairs.good: $p = Get-Content -LiteralPath page.txt -Raw; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; 'narrow sub-path PASS fetched'

pairs.bad: throw 'Request timed out after 30000ms fetching full listing <url>'
throw 'Request timed out after 30000ms fetching <url> twice in a row'
throw 'Request timed out after 30000ms fetching api path <url>'
throw 'Request timed out after 30000ms fetching raw file <url>'
throw 'Request timed out after 30000ms fetching store page <url>'
throw 'Request timed out after 30000ms fetching listing <url> during check'
throw 'Request timed out after 30000ms fetching <url> keeps timing out'
throw 'Request timed out after 30000ms fetching <url> no report'
pairs.expect: RESULT fetch PASS attempts fallback unverified
pairs.good: $u = Get-Content -LiteralPath url.txt -Raw; 'RESULT fetch PASS attempts fallback unverified'
